note: Mostly seasonal and annual sites: only a handful of the RV sites are sold by the night. Rural park in a wooded hollow near Aurora, a short drive from Kentucky Lake and Land Between the Lakes; pitched as the closest full-hookup base for Turkey Bay OHV Area, so expect ATV and side-by-side traffic. Seasonal pool, fishing pond, fish-cleaning station, playground, pavilion; limited cell signal. RV insurance required. --Claude
summary: Private, year-round, 60 FHU 30/50A sites but only 7 RV sites sold by the night on its Lodgify engine ($38-49; $44/$49 on sampled 2027 nights) plus tent sites ($25); the rest seasonal/annual. Google 4.6 / 39. Price passes. Mostly-seasonal + OHV-basecamp character = drop candidate for AWH. Stored wifi true was wrong ('Cable and Wi-Fi are not provided').
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (mostly seasonal): 'Choose from 60 full-hookup RV sites ... flexible stay options: Short-term stays Seasonal sites Annual sites'; the booking engine sells only seven RV sites by the night (#38, #39, #42, #43, #44, #45, #48), about 12% of the RV sites; tent sites are nightly too ($25; count not stated, so the share with tents can't be computed). Imagery shows most of the hollow lined with settled rigs with decks and sheds. 'Iffy' factors: OHV basecamp pitch, limited cell, 'Management Reserves the right to refuse accommodation for any RV/Camper based on its appearance'. Kept in the note as 'Mostly seasonal and annual sites' if AWH keeps it.

OHV (flag, not a drop): 'We're the closest full-hookup campground to Turkey Bay OHV Area ... Bring your ATV, side-by-side, Jeep, or motorcycle'. It is a general campground with an OHV clientele, not an OHV staging area; note caveat written.

PRICE: cheapest real night $38 (engine's undated 'from' price for #38; sampled nights $44 Jan/May/Jul for #39), summer peak $49 (2027-07-17). Under the $50 gate. Lodgify prices shown before any taxes/fees at checkout (not taken further).
